# Additive delta-merge: recover 5,905 EN translations onto the live catalog (#4220/#4387)

ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: practical
- model_x_harness: composer-2.5 × cursor CLI
- why_this_tier: continuation of atlas-land-full-en-reenrich (same lane, full context); bounded,
  invariant-guarded data merge; decision cross-checked AGREE by codex (atlas-delta-merge-check)
- owned_paths: scripts/atlas/**, scripts/lexicon/**, batch_state/full-en-reenrich-pulled/** (read)
- acceptance_cmd: pytest (affected) + ruff + existing publish gate
- alternatives_considered: full 4h47m VPS re-run without merge (wastes 5905 recoverable cards; REJECTED), wholesale pointer swap (drops 1479 entries, regresses #6432; REJECTED)
- parallel_free_seats: grok, agy

## Authorization
Your STOP in `atlas-land-full-en-reenrich` was correct. The driver + codex cross-check now
authorize option 2 from your report: an additive slug-keyed merge helper. This brief IS the
approval you asked for.

## Evidence preamble (#M-4)
Every count in your PR body quoted from raw tool output (command + cwd + output), re-derived
locally — including the invariant proofs below.

## Context (from your prior task, verified)
- Pulled lineage: `batch_state/full-en-reenrich-pulled/manifest.json`, sha256 922f04649b5e…,
  17,724 entries; all pulled slugs exist in the live catalog.
- Live published lineage: pointer 0778b59991c5…, 19,203 entries.
- Pulled carries 5,905 translation cards the live catalog lacks.

## Outcome wanted
The live catalog gains every translation card it lacks from the pulled lineage, published
through the existing publish gate in one PR — with these HARD invariants proven in the PR body:
1. Entry count stays exactly 19,203 (zero entries added or dropped).
2. Zero overwrites: an entry that already has EN keeps its existing EN untouched
   (prove: diff count of modified-but-previously-nonempty EN fields == 0).
3. The #6432 anchors (ківі, млн) keep their current live EN.
4. Old-gate no-english-anchor count does not regress (currently 48 on live; must not rise).
5. Post-merge missing_translation re-derived and quoted (expected ≈ 4943 minus recovered overlap
   — measure, don't assume).

## Steps
1. New dispatch worktree (dispatcher-created).
2. Build the merge helper in the atlas/lexicon tooling where the sibling manifest tools live —
   deterministic, fixture-tested (small synthetic manifests covering: missing-EN copy,
   existing-EN preserved, slug-absent-in-pulled ignored, count invariance).
3. Run it on the real data; capture the invariant proofs; run the existing publish gate.
4. pytest (affected) + ruff; conventional commit + X-Agent trailer; push; PR referencing #4220,
   #4387 and this brief. Do NOT arm auto-merge.
5. Report: PR number, all five invariant proofs, residual missing_translation count.

## Non-goals
- No re-enrich runs (the fresh targeted VPS run against current lineage is a SEPARATE follow-up
  the driver will queue after this merges).
- No schema changes, no shard re-export.
